title: English Practice Quiz 0915
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A guest asks about check-in time. You should ___.
options: provide the confirmed check-in time clearly
questions.explanation: provide the confirmed check-in time clearly is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A reservation is a ___.
questions.explanation: booking made in advance is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A guest reports a lost item. Staff should ___.
options: record details and follow the lost-property procedure
questions.explanation: record details and follow the lost-property procedure is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Which phrase offers assistance courteously?
questions.explanation: How may I help you? is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An accessible room is designed to ___.
questions.explanation: support guests with access needs is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A guest's personal information should be ___.
options: protected and shared only when authorised
questions.explanation: protected and shared only when authorised is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: If a room is not ready, staff should ___.
questions.explanation: apologise and explain available options is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A concierge commonly helps guests with ___.
questions.explanation: local information and arrangements is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A service standard describes ___.
questions.explanation: the expected level of service is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: At checkout, a guest should receive ___.
options: an accurate final bill and confirmation
questions.explanation: an accurate final bill and confirmation is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
